recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce or edit the old C-CDA Cognitive Status Result profile in core unless a current active artifact or new work-group decision requires it.
issue_request: FHIR-3645 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core change request reporting that an invariant was not showing in profile views or generated XML for the C-CDA Cognitive Status Result Observation profile, specifically around AdditionalInterpretationCodes.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed implementation commit was found. Commit 378a21f1b1aff7c469b88311149026829f7e3779, dated 2014-10-20, made invariants structure-specific in the spreadsheet parser and fixed C-CDA invariants, including the Cognitive Status Result invariant sheet, context, and XPath. This matches the Jira comment that the issue was resolved as part of other work.
additional_context: The affected C-CDA profile source was historical. Commit 1a42f96ce66945f26c26a41ab182f0a5fd7fbbcf later removed the old C-CDA Observation profile spreadsheets and introductions. Current source/observation has no C-CDA cognitive-status profile file, source/igs.xml comments out the C-CDA IG entry, and the only current fhir.ini mention is a legacy [tla] abbreviation alias, not an active profile source. Active current Observation definitions carry invariants as StructureDefinition constraint elements.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested historical behavior was already applied, and the specific affected profile is outside the current build scope.
